summary: The content sounds like DUMMIES: it is dry and mundane, every particle has a role, and the shakes and flashes are kept small. One reference line is wrong: the drone-dispatch row describes the chassis delivery instead of the cone drone.

issues.found: Drone lift animation already in P1 (helicopter delivery)
issues.rule: The drone dispatched after a honk flies in from off-field top right and lifts and drops a blocked cone (proto.droneSpeed, proto.droneLiftSeconds). The helicopter delivery belongs to the 'chassis' event.
issues.fix: Drone fly-in, cone pickup and drop stay as P1.2; no added field juice (Micro Machines)
